study.question: Does the small primary-click benefit of using primary-population history scores in auxiliary training depend on direct auxiliary updates to shared context embeddings, and is blocking that route a better quality/cost tradeoff under the frozen four-task recipe?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g0-r0029-aux_primary_primary and g0-r0029-aux_primary_feedback both have click AUC0.6669000087261666; the two feedback-training cells both have0.6668445431089562 (delta0.0000554656172104). Thus the eval moment source does not explain their click difference. The inspected code fully detaches reused primary strata, auxiliary scorer parameters, target, history values and all five detail inputs; context remains attached in both the auxiliary tower and task adapter. Provisional mechanism: training-population-dependent auxiliary predictions change context gradients, which change the shared context representation seen by click. Blocking context in both auxiliary paths should attenuate that population contrast. This tests a necessary direct route, not a proof of normalization superiority, useful task semantics, full task isolation, or a new architecture. A blocked-context candidate may improve click if transfer is harmful, but a gain is not assumed.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary paper1706.06978v4 lines317-335 describes Dice batch moments and moving-average inference. We inherit local activation and native Dice, plus previously tested compression/detail/task adapters; the proposed change tests backward ownership of auxiliary context at fixed normalization populations. Not an exact DIN reproduction or originality claim.

Pinned90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d lines25-33 uses nonaffine BatchNorm1d momentum0.01 and learned alpha. No activation or normalization operator changes here; all native running-state calls stay identical at a fixed parameter state.

Pinned benchmark implementation lines123-219 was read: task-masked sequence hubs, categorical/task hubs and iterative aggregation/broadcast. This suite retains existing compressed summaries and task adapters and changes only backward access to context; it adds no hub/broadcast mechanism. paper:infnet resolves to provenance only (original full paper unavailable through the supplied archive); equivalence to that paper and priority remain unverified.

The imported source already implements selective auxiliary source gradients; source read and receipt inspected. We inherit that stop-gradient primitive. This is a new factorial with the current normalization-population intervention, not an original gradient-routing method or a fresh replication of the old source-path result.

Exact standalone source hash19706ae5af5cad6020e5b6fbe48186b49bb7392834dfc8167dd61677fff7a214 verified. This suite relaxes only its context-false construction guard, uses the already-existing context.detach path, and fixes eval moments to primary in all cells.

study.proposed_difference: 2x2 factorial: auxiliary_train_population in {primary,feedback} crossed with block_aux_context_grad in {True,False}, with auxiliary_eval_population=primary throughout. New candidate primary_context_blocked differs from incumbent only by permission for auxiliary losses to backpropagate through context. Existing forward already gates aux_context before BOTH residual_features and tower features; no new detach is added elsewhere. Relax the constructor guard that previously prohibited True; retain Boolean validation and mandatory item/scorer blocks. Same-context allowed cells reproduce archived endpoints. Both native feedback-state collection and all primary computations execute in every cell. Expected no parameter, state, initialization, fixed-state probability or eval-operator difference within a population pair.
predictions: Static prediction: model modules/initialization/helpers/forward are identical to g0-r0029-aux_primary_primary after undoing only the declared context guard and CONFIG/default changes. All four modules have the same parameter/buffer layout and RNG use.

Fixed-state tensor prediction, pending authorized host checks: within each training population, changing the context block changes only backward flow; all four probabilities and running-buffer updates are equal. Eval probabilities and buffers are identical across all cells when supplied the same state because eval population is fixed to primary.

Backward prediction, pending host checks: an auxiliary-only BCE has no direct gradient into scorer, target/history/action embeddings or reused primary strata in any cell. In blocked cells its gradient into context embeddings is also absent; auxiliary tower and selected adapter gradients remain. Click-only gradients at a fixed state are unchanged by either factor. Inspect table aliasing before asserting a parameter partition.

Let D_allowed=AUC(primary_context_allowed)-AUC(feedback_context_allowed), D_blocked=AUC(primary_context_blocked)-AUC(feedback_context_blocked), and I=D_allowed-D_blocked. Direct-context mediation predicts D_allowed reproduces the positive archival delta and |D_blocked| is smaller, with positive I. This one-seed interaction is provisional; do not label statistical significance or assume D_blocked exactly zero because global dense clipping may still transmit changes.

Primary_context_allowed should bridge g0-r0029-aux_primary_primary (AUC0.6669000087261666); feedback_context_allowed should bridge g0-r0029-aux_feedback_primary (AUC0.6668445431089562). Bridge disagreement triggers execution review before attribution. Full-data sample count2871767 and all four metrics must be retained.

No inference acceleration predicted: all cells share fully_pruned eval and primary moment readout. Backward work may decrease with blocked context; measure train/wall seconds, peak memory, parameter counts and inference throughput/p50/p95 rather than infer equal compute from equal capacity.
falsifiers: If a context stop-gradient changes fixed-state predictions, primary/auxiliary running-buffer updates, initialization, input access or state layout, the matched intervention is invalid and must be corrected before mechanism claims.

If auxiliary-only losses still have a direct path to context in a blocked cell, or to scorer/item/action in any cell, the proposed ownership intervention failed; this is an implementation failure rather than scientific counterevidence.

If D_allowed is not positive in an accepted bridge, the small prior population advantage has not reproduced. If it reproduces but I is nonpositive or |D_blocked| is not smaller, the predicted dominant direct-context mediation lacks support under this recipe. A residual blocked difference can be due to clipping/numerics; without authorized gradient/clip diagnostics this remains unresolved rather than proving a different mechanism.

If new candidates do not exceed the incumbent0.6669000087261666 at acceptable measured cost, no improved model is established. If auxiliary AUC/Logloss regress, report that tradeoff even if click improves. No claim of across-task superiority: incumbent auxiliary AUCs0.78022/0.78812/0.75905 remain below DIN0.84907/0.86490/0.87018.
If execution cost exceeds the frozen per-trial cap or budget reservations cannot be maintained, stop and retain the failed attempt; never reinterpret resource failure as a null mechanism test.
alternative_explanations: The prior delta5.55e-5 is a single-seed optimization result after many adaptive rounds; no user-cluster intervals or independent repetitions are available. Selection optimism and seed variation can explain it.

Global dense gradient clipping10 is a host-owned shared scalar. Changing auxiliary predictions/tower gradients can change it even when context is blocked. AdamW epsilon, BF16 rounding and subsequent optimizer states can sustain differences. Do not modify clipping or optimizer groups to force isolation.

Context gradients could act as generic regularization or proxy supervision without semantically aligned task information; this factorial cannot distinguish those explanations or validate auxiliary label attribution.

Feedback-population vs primary-population auxiliary training changes input scores and the learned auxiliary functions together, not just a single running statistic. The previous eval factor had no click effect; calling the training effect train/eval normalization alignment is unsupported.

Independent auxiliary buffers are disjoint in source, but tensor aliases and any embedding-table sharing need host confirmation. All feedback calls are retained to avoid state/work confounds; missing host diagnostics remain missing evidence.

Earlier failures matter: g0-r0006 compressed_task0.659194 was below events_task0.660163; task queries alone did not justify complementarity. Match detail task0.663019 exceeded shared0.661646, but joint_ordered0.665644 lost to duplicate_match0.665739 and cubic_ordered0.665705 lost to gated_duplicate0.665930. Extra structure alone was not consistently useful. Mean-only0.665015 and variance-only0.665475 both underperformed both0.666754 and neither0.666124, motivating interaction controls rather than isolated favorable comparisons.
Scope remains released official_offline prefix/action visibility with whole-window vocab assumptions and category/brand auxiliary labels, not production causal validity.
